annotations.title: Get the results of a simulation you already ran

description: Checks on, and reads, a run you started with run_monte_carlo_simulation, rank_inputs_by_impact or summarize_outcome_scenarios, using its run_id. Use this when a run tool returned status running or queued: it waits up to 30 seconds for the run to finish, then returns its status and percent done, or the finished result, so call it again until status is completed. Use it also to get specific numbers from a finished simulation without running it again (a finished run keeps every node's and edge's statistics for every period): pass nodes (node, edge or metric ids), periods, percentiles such as 0.05 or 0.95, a threshold to get the chance a value is at least or at most some number, or histogram for the distribution's shape. Without those it returns the summary (or the ranking, or the scenarios). A failed run returns its error and is not charged. Only the caller who started the run can read it. Runs started without an account can be read for 24 hours, and only from the same connection, since a caller without an account is recognized by network address and client. Cost: free; uses no credits and no free runs.

histogram.description: true to also return a histogram (trial counts per value bin) for up to 3 of the rows.
histogram.title: Histogram

nodes.description: Ids of the nodes, edges or metrics (output_request.aggregations ids) to return numbers for. Default: the output nodes.
nodes.title: Nodes

percentiles.description: Percentiles to return, as fractions from 0 to 1 (0.95 is the 95th percentile). Default [0.1, 0.5, 0.9].
percentiles.title: Percentiles

period_from.description: Instead of periods: the first index of a range of periods.
period_from.title: Period From

period_to.description: Instead of periods: the last index of a range (inclusive).
period_to.title: Period To

periods.description: Time period indices to return, counting from 0. Default: the last period only. Ignored for metrics, which cover the whole run.
periods.title: Periods

run_id.description: The run_id returned by run_monte_carlo_simulation, rank_inputs_by_impact or summarize_outcome_scenarios.
run_id.title: Run Id

threshold.description: A value to test: returns, for each node and period, the chance (0 to 1) that it is at least this value (or at most it, see threshold_direction), for example the chance cash is at least 0 in month 6.
threshold.title: Threshold

threshold_direction.description: at_least (default): the chance of being greater than or equal to threshold. at_most: the chance of being less than or equal to it.
threshold_direction.title: Threshold Direction

wait_seconds.description: If the run is still going, wait up to this many seconds (0 to 50, default 30) for it to finish before answering. Returns as soon as it finishes. 0 answers at once with the current percent done.
wait_seconds.title: Wait Seconds
